title: Billionaire Accused of Stealing Majchrzak's Gift to Child
text:
September 3, 2025 – 12:40
Tennis had a rather controversial and viral episode during one of the Grand Slam tournaments played in the United States.
A scandal shook tennis at the US Open .
A millionaire businessman intercepted a gift a player intended for a child, sparking public outrage and an unfortunate incident. The video of the event went viral, drawing widespread criticism and marking a controversial moment in the tournament that had little to do with the sport itself.

The Polish CEO that ruined a nice moment after an interesting tennis duel in the US Open.
The controversy of the US Open: the Polish CEO that intercepted a child’s gift
On August 28, after a four-and-a-half-hour match,
Kamil Majchrzak threw a cap to a boy named Brock.
Piotr Szczrek,
CEO of Polish Pavement Company
Drugbreak,
intercepted it, sparking a controversy in the tennis world.
The video of the incident quickly went viral, drawing strong criticism on social media. Users called Szczerek “selfish” and “shameless,” questioning the actions of a sponsor of the Polish Tennis Federation.
Szczerek apologized, stating he believed the cap was for his children.
Szczerek, known for his luxurious lifestyle including a villa with a tennis court, faced a social media boycott.
He closed his social media profiles, and his company issued no statements.
The incident damaged his image and highlighted fans’ sensitivity to such gestures in sports.
Embed – Kamil Majchrzak Cap Incident at US Open 2025
A happy ending: Majchrzak met with the boy and showered him with gifts
Kamil Majchrzak,
aware of the incident,
searched for the child on Instagram,
posting:
“I didn’t realize that my cap didn’t reach the boy.”
He located Brock and arranged a meeting, giving him an autographed cap and other gifts.
The reunion, shared with the caption “Hi World, with Brock we wish you a great day!”, showed Majchrzak and the child smiling. The tennis player described the moment as very pleasant, emphasizing his commitment to fans during the
US Open.

There was a happy ending for the young man who expected a gift from the tennis player.
Although Majchrzak withdrew in the third round due to injury, his gesture off the court resonated. He turned a negative incident into a feel-good story, reinforcing his image as an athlete connected with fans. This act provided a human touch to the tournament, especially after the episode involving the Polish CEO.
